services.name: Oil change
services.blurb: Conventional, blend or full synthetic to your car's spec, with a new filter, in about 30 minutes.

services.name: Tune-up and spark plugs
services.blurb: New plugs gapped to spec and the coils and boots checked. Drop it off in the morning.

services.name: Engine and cabin air filters
services.blurb: Both filters pulled and shown to you next to the new ones, about ten minutes.

services.name: Tire rotation
services.blurb: Tires moved in the right pattern, pressures set to the door sticker, lugs torqued by hand.

services.name: Fluid exchanges
services.blurb: Brake fluid, coolant and transmission fluid exchanged at the mileage your manual lists.

services.name: Battery test and replacement
services.blurb: A load test in five minutes, and a new battery installed only if it fails.

services.name: Wipers and bulbs
services.blurb: Smeary blades and dead bulbs swapped while you sit, usually under ten minutes.

services.name: Mileage services
services.blurb: The 30k, 60k and 90k lists done in one drop-off, with a report of what's next.

services.name: Road trip check
services.blurb: Before Zion or Moab: tires, fluids, belts, wipers and lights checked in about twenty minutes.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Booked the 7:30 slot, sat with my laptop, and was out at 8:05 with the oil done and a note that my cabin filter could wait until spring.
reviews.name: Kenna R.

reviews.text: First car, no idea what was due at 90,000 miles. They showed me the plugs they pulled, worn round at the tips, and said the coils were fine to keep.
reviews.name: Sione F.

reviews.text: They held my cabin filter up next to a new one and it was gray with leaves. Ten minutes, done, and the stale inversion smell in the car is gone.
reviews.name: Marisa L.

reviews.text: Rotation and pressures before driving up Provo Canyon to Sundance. One tire had a slow leak from a screw; they patched it and I was still out in under an hour.
reviews.name: Dallin H.

reviews.text: My minivan battery tested weak in October. They showed me the reading, I said yes, and it was in before my coffee was cold. Started fine all winter.
reviews.name: Brooke A.

reviews.text: Dropped off for the 60k service at 7:30, got a text at 11 with the list of what was done and what wasn't due yet. Picked it up at lunch.
reviews.name: Camille W.

reviews.text: Before driving to Moab with three kids, they checked everything in about twenty minutes and swapped the wipers that were streaking. Nothing extra pushed on me.
reviews.name: Ethan P.

proof.guarantee: If it isn't due, we say so, and we write down the mileage when it will be.
